Several '''attacks on Imperial holdouts''' were made by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] after the end of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Aren't there still some Imperial strongholds in the Core Systems?''"<br />"''Sure are.|[[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Lost">''[[Young Jedi Knights: The Lost Ones]]''</ref>}}
As the Galactic Civil War came to a formal end, with the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] losing ground and ultimately signing the [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty]] with the New Republic in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC" /> many remaining Imperial warlords had turned to mass piracy.<ref name="SOTG07" /> On the other hand, some [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] [[replacement warlord]]s created the [[Second Imperium]] to continue the fight against the New Republic.<ref name="TNEGtC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> but they were [[Second Imperium Crisis|defeated]] by the New Republic and the [[New Jedi Order]] in [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]].<ref name="TNEC" />

==The attacks==
In an effort to consolidate its power and enforce security, the New Republic tracked down and eliminated rogue Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] and pirates,<ref name="SOTG07" /> focusing especially on their holdings in the Deep Core.<ref name="DW">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref> These campaigns saw the initial trial of the [[Viscount-class Star Defender|''Viscount''-class Star Defender]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], when the prototype [[Viscount (Viscount-class)|''Viscount'']] engaged Imperial ships in combat. However, engagements were rare events.<ref name="SOTG07" />

On his side, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]] targeted remnants of the Second Imperium and liberated all remaining Imperium [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress worlds]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

==Aftermath==
The outcome of these battles was the decimation of rogue Imperial forces and the end to organized Imperial piracy. Deployment of the ''Viscount'' during those skirmishes was considered as a huge waste of resources and the development of the ''Viscount''-class program was soon stopped.<ref name="SOTG07" /> The ''Viscount'' itself was later downgraded to ceremonial display.<ref name="VP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref> By the time of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the New Republic had finally cleared all the Imperial warlords out of the Deep Core.<ref name="DW" /> Admiral Ackbar would retire from service following the defeat of those last Imperial forces, in 25 ABY.<ref name="TEGtW" />
